<cite ref="Pesachim 40b:2">Pes. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>ארבא … דטָבְעָא וכ׳</he> a ship with wheat sank &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 108b:9">Sabb. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>מעולם לא ט׳ וכ׳</he> never was yet a man drowned in the Lake of Sodom.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 153a:10">B. Bath. 153ᵃ</cite> <he>אמרה לִיטְבַּע ארביה</he> (Ms. H. <he>אמרה ליה טבאי וכ׳</he>, Ar. <he>אמרה לו טבאי</he>) said she, May his (thy) ship go under; a. e.—[<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:29">Targ. <cite ref="Bava Batra 73a:8">B. Bath. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>גלא דמְטַבַּע וכ׳</he> the wave which threatens to sink the ship.
<cite ref="Chullin 60a:3">Ḥull. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>אתא מיטרא טַבְּעֵיה בימא</he> there came a rain and sank the provision into the sea.
